A failed transaction should never be a mystery.

When money moves, visibility matters.

Strong payment systems should clearly show status journey, trace ID, partner logs, retry history, failure reason, and reconciliation status.

Good engineering is not just sending money.

It is knowing what happened, why it happened, and what should happen next.

Open to remote roles, freelance projects, and consulting work in fintech, payments, backend, APIs, DevOps, and infrastructure.
